support.title: Help & support
support.subtitle: We usually reply within a day.

fare.q: Why was my fare different from the estimate?
fare.a: The final fare uses the real distance and time of your trip, plus any waiting. Your receipt shows each part.

cancel.q: When is there a cancellation fee?
cancel.a: Cancelling while we search, or shortly after a driver accepts, is free. After that, or once the driver has arrived, a fee may apply — the app always shows it before you confirm.

lost.q: I left something in the vehicle
lost.a: Open the ride from Your rides, tap "Get help with this trip" and describe the item. We'll contact the driver.

cash.a: Pay the fare shown on the trip-complete screen to your driver in cash. Digital payments are coming soon.

account.q: How do I change my name or delete my account?
account.a: Go to Profile to change your name. Settings has Delete account.
